```sql
select 100 * max(price_to_income) as value from doorstep.ch8_metros where cbsa_title in ('Lakeland-Winter Haven, FL', 'Rochester, NY') and year(median_income) = 2008 order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select 100 * max(price_to_income) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year where year = 2008 and cbsa_title in ('Lakeland-Winter Haven, FL', 'Rochester, NY') group by cbsa_title order by -max(price_to_income), cbsa_title
```

```sql
select 100 * max(price_to_income) as value, cbsa_title as label
from doorstep.mart_metro_year where year = 2008 and cbsa_title in ('Lakeland-Winter Haven, FL', 'Rochester, NY')
order by value desc, label
```

```sql

```

```sql
select 
    cbsa_title as label,
    avg(price_to_income) as value
from doorstep.ch8_metros 
where year in (2008, 2008)
group by cbsa_title
order by avg(price_to_income) desc;
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, price_to_income as value from doorstep.ch1_national_series

order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select floor(cbsa_code) as label, sum(down_payment_years) / sum(annual_rent) as value from doorstep.ch8_metros where year = 2018 and cbsa_code in ('Charleston-North Charleston, SC', 'Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR') group by cbsa_code order by value desc, cbsa_code
```

```sql
select
    concat('Charleston-North Charleston, SC', '-', cbsa_title) as label,
    sum(price_to_income) / sum(price_to_income_low) as value
from doorstep.export_ch6_largest_metros
where year = 2018 and cbsa_title in ('Charleston-North Charleston, SC', 'Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR')
group by concat('Charleston-North Charleston, SC', '-', cbsa_title), concat('Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR', '-', cbsa_title)
order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, 
       max(price_to_income) / max(price_to_income_low) / max(price_to_income_high) as value from doorstep.mart_metro_year 
       where cbsa_code in ('Charleston-North Charleston, SC', 'Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR') 
       and year = 2018 
       group by cbsa_title 
       order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select label as warehouse, value from (
    select 100 * max(ratio) as value
    from doorstep.mart_metro_year
    where year = 2018
    and cbsa_title = 'Charleston-North Charleston, SC'
    or cbsa_title = 'Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR'
    order by value desc
) t
select max(100 * max(ratio)) as value
from (
    select label as warehouse, value from (
        select 100 * max(ratio) as value
        from doorstep.mart_metro_year
        where year = 2018
        and cbsa_title = 'Charleston-North Charleston, SC'
        or cbsa_title = 'Fayetteville-Springdale-Rogers, AR'
        group by warehouse
    ) t
    order by value desc
)
```

SELECT c2.carrier as label, c2.flights / c1.flights as value
FROM turnaround.mart_carrier_month c1, turnaround.export_ch1_by_year c2
WHERE c1.year = 2016 AND c2.carrier IN ('HA', 'WN')
ORDER BY value DESC, label;

SELECT carrier AS label, CAST(sum(on_time) / SUM(scheduled) AS DOUBLE) * 100 AS value
FROM turnaround.export_ch4_buffer_curve
WHERE carrier IN ('HA', 'WN')
AND year(16) = 2016
GROUP BY carrier
ORDER BY value DESC, label
UNION ALL
SELECT carrier AS label, CAST(sum(on_time) / SUM(scheduled) AS DOUBLE) * 100 AS value

```sql
select 100 * max(on_time) - max(on_time) as value from turnaround.export_ch1_by_year a, turnaround.mart_carrier_month b, turnaround.export_ch3_by_carrier c, turnaround.export_ch4_buffer_curve d, turnaround.export_ch5_ranking e
where a.Year = b.year = 2016 and a.carrier != 'WN' and a.carrier in ('HA', 'WN') and c.carrier = a.carrier and e.Rank = a.Rank
order by a.Year, a.carrier
```

```sql
select cbsa_title as label, 50 * floor(max(ratio) + 0.5) as value from doorstep.fct_metro_year where cbsa_title in ('Peoria, IL', 'Scranton--Wilkes-Barre, PA') and year(median_income) = 2015 group by cbsa_title order by value desc, label
```

```sql
select 
  t1.cbsa_title as label, 
  cast(t1.median_income as DOUBLE) as value1,
  cast(t2.median_income as DOUBLE) as value2
from doorstep.fct_metro_year t1
left join doorstep.fct_metro_year t2 on t1.cbsa_code = t2.cbsa_code and t1.states = 'Scranton--Wilkes-Barre, PA' and t1.year = 2015
where t2.median_income > t1.median_income
order by value1 desc, value2 desc
having (value1 > value2 and value1 != value2)
```

```sql
and year(in('2015', 2016)) = 2015
order by owner_median_income desc, owner_median_income asc
```

```sql
with ordered_cancelled AS (
    SELECT
        carrier AS label,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(cancelled) / scheduled, 
            0,
            0 // fallback for NULL or 0
        ) as percentage AS value
    FROM turnaround.mart_carrier_month
    WHERE year = 2024
    AND carrier IN ('AS', '9E')
    GROUP BY carrier
),
ranked_cancelled AS (
    SELECT
        carrier AS label,
        percentage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage DESC) AS rn
    FROM ordered_cancelled
)
SELECT label, value
FROM ranked_cancelled
WHERE rn = 1
LIMIT 1;
```

with leading_price AS (

select airport, CAST(
    (sum(cancelled) * rate * 100.0 / total_scheduled)
) as value,
CAST(
    (sum(cancelled) * rate * 100.0 / total_scheduled)
) as value,
airport as label,
from (
    SELECT 
        airport,
        sum(cancelled) as cancelled,
        sum(scheduled) as scheduled,
        sum(scheduled) * CAST(rate AS DOUBLE) / 100.0 as rate,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_scheduled = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE sum(cancelled) * rate * 100.0 / total_scheduled
        END as rate_pct
    FROM turnaround.mart_carrier_month
    LEFT JOIN turnaround.mart_airport_day ON airport = airport
    WHERE flight_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND airport IN ('MIA', 'ORD')
    GROUP BY airport, total_scheduled, rate
    ORDER BY value DESC
    LIMIT 1
) as t
join doorstep.fct_metro_year ON t.airport = fct_m

```sql
select 100 * city_cancelled / citycheduled as value from (
    SELECT 
        c.carrier,
        c.year,
        SUM(causelate_aircraft) / SUM(causelate_aircraft + causallate) AS city_cancelled,
        SUM(causallate) / SUM(causallate + causelate) AS citycheduled
    FROM turnaround.mart_carrier_month c
    JOIN turnaround.mart_airport_day causelate_aircraft ON c.carrier = causelate_aircraft.carrier
    JOIN turnaround.mart_airport_day causallate ON c.carrier = causallate.carrier
    JOIN turnaround.export_ch6_nas_by_airport causelate_aircraft_pickup ON c.carrier = causelate_aircraft_pickup.airport
    JOIN turnaround.export_ch6_nas_by_airport causallate_pickup ON c.carrier = causallate_pickup.airport
    WHERE c.year = 2021
    AND c.carrier IN ('G4', 'F9')
    GROUP BY c.carrier
    ORDER BY value desc
) AS ranked
```
